remarks: Your dream apartment awaits! Situated directly on the scenic Norwalk River, the Marquis offers luxury living in a prime location! - This spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom unit features an updated kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, and large center island - Two oversized bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms in both! - Additional half-bathroom in hallway - Open concept living/dining room with laminate flooring and partial water view - Private laundry room - Tons of closet space! - Gas Heat and Central Air - Complex features a gym on the first floor and a billiards room in the adjacent building - Storage unit included - Assigned parking for one car + plenty of guest parking - Walk right out your building door to a courtyard, picnic area, and waterfront boardwalk! - Central location right off of I-95, adjacent to downtown Wall Street, and a short drive down the road to Calf Pasture beach! - Pets considered on a case-by-case basis
